Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379),

I am much obliged for the cheque, I feel as if I hardly deserved it after all the trouble I have given [Mr Freeman](/person/523).[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^2]: CMY\'s [History of France](/book/99) had been heavily revised after criticism from E. A. Freeman, the editor of the \'Historical Course for Schools\' series.
